events.saturn.Conjunction.Sun: Restriction and responsibility around who you are. Your identity gets measured by what you can carry and finish, and what no longer holds weight drops away.
events.saturn.Square.Sun: Pressure against your sense of self. Obstacles and delays make recognition harder to earn, and you decide what you are willing to build.
events.saturn.Opposition.Sun: Other people hold up a mirror to your identity. Duties to others clash with what you want for yourself, and a choice gets made.
events.saturn.Conjunction.Moon: A heavy, serious stretch emotionally. Feelings are held back and put under control, and home and family matters weigh more than usual.
events.saturn.Square.Moon: Emotional strain and unmet needs. Duty competes with comfort, and you are asked to look after yourself without waiting for others to.
events.saturn.Opposition.Moon: Responsibility toward other people runs against your own emotional needs. A relationship or home arrangement is tested for what it can hold.
events.saturn.Conjunction.Ascendant: A more serious way of presenting yourself. People start to see you as responsible, and your public image is rebuilt around maturity.
events.saturn.Square.Ascendant: Pressure on how you come across. Obstacles show up in dealings with other people, and your approach has to become more disciplined.
events.saturn.Opposition.Ascendant: Others hold up a mirror. Relationships ask for more commitment, and what you avoided showing gets reflected back at you.
events.saturn.Return: Saturn comes back to where it was at birth, about every 29 years. The structures you built are reviewed: what has held up stays, and what has not is dropped.
events.saturn.Square.Own: A mid-cycle test of your long-term structure. The work, routines and commitments you set up are checked for strain, and the weak parts get rebuilt.
events.saturn.Opposition.Own: The halfway point of Saturn's cycle. Your plans are measured against what they have met so far, and you adjust direction before the next stretch.
events.uranus.Conjunction.Sun: A break with your old identity. Sudden changes and a need for freedom push you to live as yourself and drop the roles that confine you.
events.uranus.Square.Sun: Restlessness and disruption in how you live. Events interrupt your routines, and you are pushed to change course or assert your independence.
events.uranus.Opposition.Sun: Other people or outside events shake your identity. A relationship or situation demands change, and your need for freedom collides with what you have committed to.
events.uranus.Conjunction.Moon: Sudden change at home and in your feelings. Restlessness, and a push to break old emotional habits.
events.uranus.Square.Moon: Emotional unrest and disrupted routines. Home life changes without warning, and old comfort patterns stop working.
events.uranus.Opposition.Moon: Unsettled feelings about home and closeness. Others pull away or push for change, and you loosen your hold on what felt secure.
events.uranus.Conjunction.Ascendant: A sudden change of image. You show up differently, and may change your appearance, direction or the way you meet people.
events.uranus.Square.Ascendant: Disruption in how you present yourself. Unexpected events change your plans and how others see you, and you act more independently.
events.uranus.Opposition.Ascendant: Others bring sudden change. Relationships and partnerships shift without warning, and you are pushed to be more independent inside them.
events.uranus.Square.Own: A restless push for change in your adult life. The freedoms you have claimed are tested, and you reconsider what you have settled for.
events.uranus.Opposition.Own: The midlife shake-up. The life you built is questioned, and the urge to change whatever no longer fits grows strong.
events.neptune.Conjunction.Sun: Your sense of self blurs. Dreams, idealism and doubt grow stronger, and it is harder to see where you stand until you find what you believe in.
events.neptune.Square.Sun: Confusion about direction and energy. Plans lose focus, and you are drawn toward ideals or escapes that do not hold up.
events.neptune.Opposition.Sun: Other people appear in an ideal or confusing light. Promises and trust need extra care, because what is presented may not be what it seems.
events.neptune.Conjunction.Moon: Heightened sensitivity. Moods are harder to read, intuition grows, and you absorb the feelings of those around you.
events.neptune.Square.Moon: Emotional fog and a pull toward escape. Your needs go unclear, and you may give more than you can carry.
events.neptune.Opposition.Moon: Other people's needs blur your own. Closeness brings idealizing and disappointment, so boundaries need to be clear.
events.neptune.Conjunction.Ascendant: A softening of how you appear. You are more impressionable, others see in you what they want to see, and you present yourself less sharply.
events.neptune.Square.Ascendant: Your image blurs. You may feel misunderstood or lose track of your direction, and you need firm footing.
events.neptune.Opposition.Ascendant: Others pull on you in confusing ways: idealized relationships, or dealings where the facts are unclear.
events.neptune.Square.Own: A stretch of questioning the ideals your life was built around. Faith, vision and dreams are checked against what has happened, and the disillusion clears space for a truer picture.
events.pluto.Conjunction.Sun: A deep turning point in identity. An old version of you ends, and a stronger one forms through loss, pressure and the removal of what no longer works.
events.pluto.Square.Sun: Pressure and power struggles force change. Something you hold onto is stripped away, and you come out surer of what you value.
events.pluto.Opposition.Sun: Others bring intense pressure. A relationship or an authority challenges you, and the struggle shows what you will and will not give up.
events.pluto.Conjunction.Moon: Emotions run deep. Old feelings come up to be dealt with, and home and family circumstances change at the root.
events.pluto.Square.Moon: Intense emotional pressure. Hidden feelings, control issues or family matters surface, and you have to face them to move on.
events.pluto.Opposition.Moon: Others stir your deepest emotions. Closeness brings control, jealousy or letting go, and an emotional bond is rebuilt or ended.
events.pluto.Conjunction.Ascendant: A transformation of how you appear. You change your image, and others meet a stronger, more intense version of you.
events.pluto.Square.Ascendant: Pressure on your public self. Power struggles shape how you present and deal with people, and you shed an old image.
events.pluto.Opposition.Ascendant: Intense change arrives through other people. A powerful person or relationship makes you look at control and redefine yourself.
events.pluto.Square.Own: A deep re-examination of power and control in your life. Long-held patterns are challenged at their root.
events.jupiter.Return: Jupiter comes back to where it was at birth, about every 12 years. A new cycle of growth begins: optimism rises, and a chance appears to expand your work, learning or beliefs.
events.nn.Return: The Nodes come back to their birth position about every 19 years. Direction resets: questions about purpose and what you are growing toward come up again, and old habits are weighed against where you are heading.
